title: helianthemum apenninum var. croceum
intro: Helianthemum apenninum var. croceum, commonly known as Rock Rose, is a flowering plant species in the family Cistaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Rock Rose include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain and inflammation, as well as treating wounds and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Rock Rose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are often used in herbal remedies.
